svg.text: Dependent Type Fibers Gcd(x, y) Collapse Along Euclid's Cut Trajectories
Dependent family (x, y) ↦ Gcd(x, y) over ℕ × ℕ, and symbolic evidence preservation for unknown (x, y)
1. Dependent Index Plane (x, y) and Iso-Type Fibers
Every trajectory (x, y) → (y, x mod y) stays inside one fiber Gcd = {g}:
• Halting on x-axis (y = 0) reveals the fiber's unique inhabitant x = g!
2. Symbolic Verification for Unknown (x, y) in Codillon
At compile time (x, y) are unknown (indigo), yet the proof is exact:
For any unknown d: (d ∣ x ∧ d ∣ y) ⇔ (d ∣ y ∧ d ∣ (x mod y))
Codillon Structured Wasm — Live Refinement Type Pane
g : { v ∈ ℕ | Div(v) = Div(a) ∩ Div(b) }
Invariant I: Div(x) ∩ Div(y) = Div(a) ∩ Div(b)
I holds on entry: Div(a) ∩ Div(b) = Div(a) ∩ Div(b)
Branch evidence: y = 0 ⇒ Div(y) = Div(0) = ℕ
Else branch: y > 0 ⇒ x mod y is well-defined
Evidence erased at runtime; Wasm emits raw i32.rem_u
